entries.title: Psalms 42:1
segments:
PSALM XLII. 
 
  The psalmist longs for the public service of God, ver. 1-4.   Stirs himself up to trust in God, ver. 5-9.   Reproached by his enemies, still hopes in him, ver. 10, 11.   To the chief musician, Maschil, for the sons of Korah. 
 
Title of the psalm.  Sons of Korah-Who were an eminent order of singers in the house of God,

. 
 
  V. 1. Panteth-After the enjoyment of thee in thy sanctuary.

entries.title: Psalms 42:2
segments: V. 2. Thirsteth-Not after vain useless idols, but after the only true and living God.  Appear-In the place of his special presence and publick worship.

entries.title: Psalms 42:4
segments: V. 4. Remember-My banishment from God's presence, and mine enemies triumphs.  In me-I breathe out my sorrows and complaints to God within my own breast.  The multitudes-Israelites, who went thither in great numbers.  Holy-day-Or that kept the feast, the three solemn festival solemnities, which they kept holy unto the Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 42:5
segments: V. 5. For-Heb. for the salvations of his face, for those supports, deliverances and comforts which I doubt not I shall enjoy both in his presence and sanctuary, and from his presence, and the light of his countenance.

entries.title: Psalms 42:6
segments: V. 6. Therefore-Therefore that I may revive my drooping spirits. Remember-I will consider thy infinite mercy and power, and faithfulness. Mizar-From all the parts of the land, to which I shall be driven; whether from the parts beyond Jordan on the east: or mount Hermon, which was in the northern parts.

entries.title: Psalms 42:7
segments: V. 7. Deep-One affliction comes immediately after another, as if it were called for by the former.  A metaphor taken from violent and successive showers of rain; which frequently come down from heaven, as it were at the noise, or call of God's water spouts.

entries.title: Psalms 42:8
segments: V. 8. Command-Will effectually confer upon me.  Loving-kindness-His blessings, the effects of his loving-kindness.

entries.title: Psalms 42:10
segments: V. 10. As-As a sword, which cutteth the very bones, so painful are their reproaches.
